title: Ventspils Castle
geometryBasis: The native OpenStreetMap outline and the Latvian Geospatial Information Agency ground model constrain placement. The exact public-domain Qualla photo provides the preserved tower and wall elevations, materials and roof shapes.
sectionBasis: The museum research describes the southeast tower and the historic quadrangle. The original dimensions inform the present roof proportions. A modern glass courtyard cover is included.
limitations: The current museum exterior, chapel and characteristic tower follow the historic quadrangle and original Qualla view. A number of small openings and rear facade details are estimated.
The current glazed cover is represented by an unobtrusive modeled roof. The courtyard interior and its collection are outside the exterior scope.
